preview: St Kitts & Nevis Patriots face Jamaica Kingsmen in CPL 2026 Match 18 at Warner Park. The match is scheduled for Thu 27 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: The Patriots unite CPL's leading career run-scorer Johnson Charles with Andre Fletcher, while Jason Holder returns to strengthen an experienced Caribbean group. The CPL's newest franchise restores a Jamaica-based men's team, led by a local group featuring Rovman Powell, Andre Russell and Odean Smith. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
